claims: Artemis II is scheduled to launch on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II has a targeted lift-off time of 6:24 PM EDT (2224 GMT).
Artemis II is scheduled to launch from Launch Complex 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis II will send four astronauts around the Moon.
Artemis II marks the first crewed lunar flight since 1972.
The Artemis II launch window is open until 7:24 PM CT.
The mission goal of Artemis II is a 10-day crewed test flight around the Moon.
The crew of Artemis II is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
If Artemis II is delayed, subsequent launch windows are available starting April 2, 2026.
Artemis I was an uncrewed mission.
Artemis I successfully launched on November 16, 2022.
